capabilities: Display analog or digital clocks in a sidebar pane
Track up to four timezones in a 2x2 world-clock grid
Add custom cities using IANA timezone identifiers with DST handling
Customize dial layout, colors, typography, and second-hand movement
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in clock or world-time display, so users must leave the app to check other timezones.
summary: Sidebar clock pane with customizable analog and digital faces for tracking local time and up to four world timezones.
